headline: Priorities 1 and 2 are nearly done. Cost and accuracy do not depend on the mesh in 2D, and cost does not in 3D; accuracy improves with bank width up to r = 384. But in both 2D and 3D a spectral full-order solver on a coarse grid is faster at equal accuracy (kill criterion K2 fires), so the paper leads with mesh-independence. The POD baseline comparison is still running; priority 3 is being designed.
